pages.text: Serene Seasons runs the calendar: four seasons, each in three parts (early, mid, late), each part $(bold)16 days$(). A year is 192 days. The world was born in early spring.$(br2)Grass and leaves change colour. Snow falls and stays in winter, and melts in spring. Storms are seasonal.
The calendar shows the date and season. Keep one in your inventory; the capital keeps one by the bell.
A season sensor emits redstone by season: greenhouse shutters, a bell that rings on the first day of spring.

$(li)$(bold)Spring:$() thaw, planting, breeding.$(li)$(bold)Summer:$() long days, heat, the main harvest.$(li)$(bold)Autumn:$() second harvest, pumpkins, storing.$(li)$(bold)Winter:$() snow, cold, dark early; berries and whatever is under glass.$(br2)Animals, fish and crops all follow the year. Plan around it, or fight it with glass.
